caption: The drawing features a symmetrical arrangement of objects on a textured beige background. At the top is a stylized cross outlined in red with yellow and blue interior patterns, and rays or bursts in yellow extending from behind the cross. Below the cross is a bow-like structure composed of four elongated, rounded shapes outlined in blue and filled with red, yellow, and blue dots, converging at a small central circle. Flanking this bow arrangement are two wing-like forms in yellow with tips in red. The bottom half of the composition is dominated by a large circular shape featuring a radial, mandala-like pattern. This circle is outlined in red and decorated with repeating geometric shapes in red, yellow, and blue, forming a complex, symmetrical design centered around a blue dot at the very center. The overall composition uses a limited palette of red, yellow, and blue against the beige background, with all elements arranged in a vertically aligned manner.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
